newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hundt says German growth insufficient for new jobs.
newsitem.headline: Hundt says German growth insufficient for new jobs.

text.p: The president of the German federal employers' association, Dieter Hundt, said on Wednesday that he did not expect a quick reduction in Germany's record unemployment levels of about 4.5 million people.
Hundt told the mass-circulation Bild newspaper that current economic growth in Germany was not sufficient to create enough jobs and that growth above three percent would be necessary.
"The economic growth predicted for this year of about 2.5 percent is not sufficient to create new jobs in a large capacity," Hundt told the newspaper in the interview.
He said Bonn's efforts to reform the tax system would provide impulses to create new jobs but he also called on the government to reduce the social costs faced by employers.
